event.text: When the room spins, does it stop completely within seconds to a minute, or does it linger longer?
event.why: Symptom duration helps distinguish benign positional vertigo (very brief, under a minute) from other vestibular causes and guides need for urgent evaluation.

event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review this in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target; if you can't get that review today, contact another primary care or urgent care option. Your spinning sounds position-triggered and settles on its own, but how long each episode lasts is unclear, so a clinician should confirm the pattern and discuss positional testing or treatment. Call 911 right away if you develop new weakness, numbness, trouble speaking or seeing, or trouble walking. Seek same-day care if the spinning becomes constant, or you develop new hearing loss, severe headache or vomiting you can't control.
